taxBrackets.label: Federal tax brackets
taxBrackets.source: Federal rates for 2025. The lowest rate went from 15% to 14% on July 1, 2025, so 14.5% applies for the year.

creditRate.label: Federal credit rate
creditRate.source: Rate for federal non-refundable tax credits in 2025 (the 2025 lowest rate)

basicPersonalAmountMax.label: Basic personal amount, full
basicPersonalAmountMax.source: Basic personal amount for 2025, net income up to the start of the 26% bracket

basicPersonalAmountMin.label: Basic personal amount, minimum
basicPersonalAmountMin.source: Basic personal amount for 2025, net income from the start of the 33% bracket

basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart.label: Net income where the amount starts to go down
basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart.source: Start of the 26% bracket for 2025: the basic personal amount goes down from here

basicPersonalAmountPhaseEnd.label: Net income where the amount reaches its minimum
basicPersonalAmountPhaseEnd.source: Start of the 33% bracket for 2025: the basic personal amount reaches its minimum here

cppBaseRate.label: CPP base rate
cppBaseRate.source: CPP base contribution rate for employees (4.95%): this part is a credit, line 30800

cppTotalRate.label: CPP rate for employees
cppTotalRate.source: CPP contribution rate for employees in 2025 (5.95%): base plus the first enhancement, which is a deduction, line 22215

T1.22215.label: Deduction for CPP enhanced contributions on employment income
T1.22215.source: Schedule 8 for employees: the first enhancement (1% of 5.95%) and all second CPP contributions are deducted

T1.30000.label: Basic personal amount
T1.30000.formula:
round(param.basicPersonalAmountMax
  - (param.basicPersonalAmountMax - param.basicPersonalAmountMin)
  * clamp(line.T1.23600 - param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart, 0, param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseEnd - param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart)
  / (param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseEnd - param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart), 2)
T1.30000.source: Line 30000 worksheet: the full amount up to the 26% bracket, going down to the minimum at the 33% bracket

T1.30800.label: Base CPP contributions through employment
T1.30800.source: Schedule 8 for employees: the base part (4.95% of 5.95%) is a credit

T1.33800.label: Credit amounts at the credit rate

T1.43700.label: Total income tax deducted
T1.43700.source: Federal and provincial tax together, as the T4 shows it

T4.title: T4 Statement of Remuneration Paid
T4.about: Employment income an employer paid, and the tax, CPP, EI and dues it withheld
